items.title: Middlesex beat Leicestershire to win One-Day Cup
items.description: Middlesex claim their first silverware in a decade as they beat Leicestershire in a thrilling One-Day Cup final.

items.title: 'Beat the Aussies' - new England coach Fleming's key aim
items.description: New Test coach Stephen Fleming says he shares English cricket’s “obsession” with the Ashes and arrives with the goal to “beat the Aussies”.

items.title: Fleming on England discipline, Stokes, late arrival and coaching styles
items.description: Read what England's new Test coach Stephen Fleming had to say about Bazball, Ben Stokes, the team's discipline issues and his own philosophy.

items.title: England crush Sri Lanka to top T20 world rankings
items.description: England steamroller Sri Lanka in the third T20 to complete a 3-0 series clean sweep and return to number one in the world rankings.

items.title: England thump Sri Lanka to sweep T20 series 3-0
items.description: England steamroll Sri Lanka to complete a 3-0 series clean sweep and return to number one in the T20 world rankings.

items.title: Zimbabwe v Australia - third ODI scorecard
items.description: Latest scorecard from the third and final one-day international between Zimbabwe and Australia in Harare.

items.title: England beat Sri Lanka by six wickets to take T20 series win
items.description: England's impressive T20 form continues as they thrash Sri Lanka by six wickets in Cardiff to seal the series with a match to spare.

items.title: Blaze win One-Day Cup in last-ball thriller
items.description: Emma Jones seals the Blaze's treble success with a dramatic last-ball boundary to win a thrilling One-Day Cup final and shatter Hampshire's hopes of silverware.

items.title: Somerset title hopes fade after defeat by Yorkshire
items.description: Somerset's hopes of a first-ever County Championship title are dented with a heavy defeat at Yorkshire.

items.title: Notts' title chances dented by loss to Sussex
items.description: Nottinghamshire's hopes of a successful title defence are all but over after a loss by seven wickets to Sussex at Hove.

items.title: Hampshire relegated as Leicestershire keep survival hopes alive
items.description: Hampshire are relegated from Division One as Leicestershire chase a target of 334 to keep their own survival hopes alive.

items.title: Northants frustrated by rain in Derbyshire draw
items.description: Northamptonshire's promotion hopes are dented as rain denies them the chance to close out victory against Derbyshire.

items.title: Brook & Baker shine as England crush Sri Lanka
items.description: Harry Brook hit 114 not out in the first innings set up England with a total of 254 proving to difficult for Sri Lanka to chase leading to a England win by 119 runs after bowling out Sri Lanka.

items.title: 'What an innings' - Brook hits century against Sri Lanka
items.description: Watch the best of Harry Brook's sensational century against Sri Lanka from just 42 balls, the joint-second fastest hundred by an Englishman in a T20I.

items.title: Root and Cox to the rescue as England beat Pakistan in third Test
items.description: Captain Joe Root and Jordan Cox help England fight back from an early scare as the hosts recover from 2-2, to successfully chase down 130 and wrap up an eight-wicket win and a 3-0 series clean sweep against Pakistan at Edgbaston.

items.title: 'Celebrations cut short!' - no-ball saves Root after being bowled
items.description: England captain Joe Root gets a huge let-off after being bowled for 23 by Mohammed Ali, but the dismissal is overturned after the delivery was a no-ball, with England 35-2, chasing 130 to win the third and final Test at Edgbaston.

items.title: 'We'll celebrate' - Root praises team for ignoring 'chaos' in series win
items.description: England captain Joe Root says he's "proud" of his squad after they beat Pakistan on day four of the third Test to seal a 3-0 series win against Pakistan at Edgbaston.

items.title: Glamorgan beat Surrey to seal Divison One status
items.description: Glamorgan ensure Division One survival by completing the double over Surrey with their first win at The Oval since 2014.

items.title: Rain arrives with Middlesex needing one Glos wicket
items.description: Rain prevents Middlesex taking the one wicket they needed to beat Gloucestershire in Bristol.

items.title: Carse assault investigation dropped by police
items.description: England fast bowler Brydon Carse will face no further police action after an investigation into an alleged assault in Derby last month is dropped.

items.title: England's Gibson to stay at Somerset through 2028
items.description: England all-rounder Dani Gibson signs a two-year contract extension to stay with Somerset to the end of the 2028 season.

items.title: Traumatised Smith says he was 'thrown to wolves' over 'sandpapergate'
items.description: Australia batter Steve Smith says he is still traumatised by the aftermath of the ball-tampering scandal in 2018 and still gets flashbacks.

items.title: Test Match Special Podcast
items.description: Reaction to England’s series win over Sri Lanka with T20 World Cup winner Dawid Malan.

items.title: 'What a start!' - England lose Duckett and Gay in first over
items.description: England get off to a dreadful start on day four of the final Test as Muhammad Abbas removes Ben Duckett and Emilio Gay in the first over, to leave the home side 2-2, chasing 130 to win at Edgbaston.

items.title: Razaullah steals the show as Pakistan fight back to frustrate England
items.description: Shan Masood, Babar Azam and debutant Razaullah all reach half-centuries as Pakistan produce a spirited fight back to score 449 in their second innings on day three, setting England 130 to win the third and final Test, and complete a 3-0 series win at Edgbaston.

items.title: 'He's a star' - Razaullah shines brightest to leave England flustered
items.description: After picking up four wickets in England's first innings, 21-year-old Razaullah steals the show at Edgbaston with the bat, scoring 81 off 63 balls to help Pakistan set England a target of 130 to win the third and final Test of the series.

items.title: Diving duo - Lawrence and Cox produce brilliant catches for England
items.description: Dan Lawrence and Jordan Cox both produce brilliant, diving catches to dismiss Shan Masood and Babar Azam respectively, with both batters having caused problems for England on day three of the third Test at Edgbaston.

items.title: Calm, classy but no century - brilliant Masood frustrates England
items.description: Watch the best shots from Pakistan batter Shan Masood as he slows down England's charge towards victory in the third Test, but falls just short of a century after a brilliant catch by Dan Lawrence at Edgbaston.

items.title: England march to early win over Pakistan held up by rain
items.description: Harry Brook, Dan Lawrence, Jamie Smith and Ollie Robinson all post half-centuries on day two of the third Test for England, with rain the only respite for a Pakistan side trailing by 268.

items.title: One over, two wickets, no runs - Robinson starts with a bang
items.description: England's Ollie Robinson starts the Pakistan innings by taking two wickets in a maiden over in what has been a dominant series for the bowler.
